cards.example_en: Bad news can spread quickly through a small school.
cards.example_zh: 坏消息能在一所小学校里迅速传播。

cards.example_en: Blossom covers the playground trees in early spring.
cards.example_zh: 早春的时候，操场上的树开满了花。

cards.example_en: We ate lunch at a square table in the canteen.
cards.example_zh: 我们在食堂的一张方桌旁吃了午饭。

cards.example_en: Drawing a plan is the first stage of our poster.
cards.example_zh: 画草图是我们制作海报的第一阶段。

cards.example_en: She chose a panda stamp for the letter to Beijing.
cards.example_zh: 她给寄往北京的信选了一张熊猫邮票。

cards.example_en: We stand behind the white line while the train passes.
cards.example_zh: 火车经过时，我们站在白线后面。

cards.example_en: This essay is below the standard our teacher set.
cards.example_zh: 这篇文章没有达到老师定下的标准。

cards.example_en: A famous film star waved to us outside the cinema.
cards.example_zh: 一位著名的电影明星在电影院外向我们招手。

cards.example_en: The film will start at seven in the school hall.
cards.example_zh: 电影将于七点在学校礼堂开始。

cards.example_en: In its solid state, water becomes ice in the freezer.
cards.example_zh: 水处于固态时，放进冰箱就会变成冰。

cards.example_en: We missed the train and waited an hour at the station.
cards.example_zh: 我们误了那趟火车，在车站等了一个小时。

cards.example_en: Can you stay for dinner after the piano lesson?
cards.example_zh: 钢琴课结束后，你能留下来吃晚饭吗？

cards.example_en: Nobody should steal food from another student's bag.
cards.example_zh: 谁都不应该从别的同学书包里偷食物。

cards.example_en: I heard one slow step on the stairs after midnight.
cards.example_zh: 午夜过后，我听见楼梯上有一下缓慢的脚步。

cards.example_en: Wet leaves stick to our shoes on autumn paths.
cards.example_zh: 在秋天的小路上，湿叶子会粘在我们的鞋上。

cards.example_en: It is still raining outside.
cards.example_zh: 外面还在下雨。

cards.example_en: Ice cream before dinner upset my stomach badly.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前吃了冰淇淋，把我的肚子吃坏了。

cards.example_en: A flat stone skipped three times across the pond.
cards.example_zh: 一块扁石头在池塘上打出了三个水漂。

cards.example_en: The bus will stop outside the museum at noon.
cards.example_zh: 公交车中午会停在博物馆外面。

cards.example_en: I bought eggs at the store before it closed.
cards.example_zh: 商店关门之前，我买了鸡蛋。

cards.example_en: The storm kept us inside.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨让我们待在室内。

cards.example_en: Grandma's story about the lost dog made us laugh.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶讲的那只走失小狗的故事把我们逗笑了。

cards.example_en: Go straight down this road.
cards.example_zh: 沿着这条路直走。

cards.example_en: A strange cat followed us home from the park.
cards.example_zh: 一只陌生的猫从公园跟着我们回了家。

cards.example_en: He dropped a ripe strawberry into the cold yoghurt.
cards.example_zh: 他把一颗熟草莓放进了冰酸奶里。

cards.example_en: Cars crawl along our street when children arrive.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们到校的时候，车辆在我们这条马路上缓慢行驶。

cards.example_en: Sleep can reduce stress before an exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试前睡觉能减轻压力。

cards.example_en: Our strict teacher checks homework at the start of every lesson.
cards.example_zh: 我们严格的老师每节课开始时都会检查作业。

cards.example_en: Tom is strong enough to carry the heavy box upstairs.
cards.example_zh: 汤姆很强壮，能把沉重的箱子搬上楼。

cards.example_en: Only one student remembered a ruler for maths.
cards.example_zh: 只有一个学生上数学课时记得带尺子。

cards.example_en: I study chemistry with my friend on Sunday evenings.
cards.example_zh: 我星期日晚上和朋友一起学习化学。

cards.example_en: I prefer her plain style to very fancy writing.
cards.example_zh: 比起花哨的文字，我更喜欢她朴素的风格。

cards.example_en: Physics became my hardest subject after the test.
cards.example_zh: 那次测试之后，物理成了我最难的科目。

cards.example_en: If you keep trying, you will succeed.
cards.example_zh: 如果你继续努力，你就会成功。

cards.example_en: Finishing the race was a real success for him.
cards.example_zh: 对他来说，跑完这场比赛是一次真正的成功。

cards.example_en: It was such a sunny day.
cards.example_zh: 那是非常晴朗的一天。

cards.example_en: A sudden shower sent everyone running under the trees.
cards.example_zh: 突然下起阵雨，大家都跑到树下躲避。

cards.example_en: Many people suffer from hay fever in late spring.
cards.example_zh: 晚春时节，许多人因花粉热而受苦。

cards.example_en: I stopped putting sugar in my morning cocoa.
cards.example_zh: 我早上喝可可时不再放糖了。

cards.example_en: Could you suggest a quiet place for group study?
cards.example_zh: 你能建议一个适合小组学习的安静地方吗？

cards.example_en: Does this blue jacket suit me for the interview?
cards.example_zh: 这件蓝色夹克适合我面试时穿吗？

cards.example_en: Last summer we camped beside a river for a week.
cards.example_zh: 去年夏天，我们在河边露营了一个星期。

cards.example_en: The afternoon sun made the classroom too hot.
cards.example_zh: 下午的太阳把教室晒得太热了。

cards.example_en: It's sunny, so let's go to the park.
cards.example_zh: 天气晴朗，我们去公园吧。

cards.example_en: We buy milk at the supermarket.
cards.example_zh: 我们在超市买牛奶。

cards.example_en: My friends support me when I feel nervous.
cards.example_zh: 我紧张时朋友们支持我。

cards.example_en: I suppose the match will continue if the rain stops.
cards.example_zh: 我想如果雨停了，比赛就会继续。

cards.example_en: Are you sure the homework is in your backpack?
cards.example_zh: 你确定作业在你的背包里吗？

cards.example_en: Thick dust covered the surface of the old piano.
cards.example_zh: 厚厚的灰尘盖住了那架旧钢琴的表面。

cards.example_en: Mum's surprise was tickets to the weekend match.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈给的惊喜是周末比赛的门票。

word.example_en: The letters UN stand for an organisation.
word.example_zh: 字母 UN 代表一个组织。

word.example_en: Her opening line will stand out.
word.example_zh: 她的开头一句会显得突出。

word.example_en: Stick to your plan, and do a little each day.
word.example_zh: 坚持你的计划，每天做一点。

word.example_en: Mr Li is strict with our homework.
word.example_zh: 李老师对我们的作业很严格。

word.example_en: The date is subject to change.
word.example_zh: 日期视情况而定，可能更改。

word.example_en: She may succeed in the speech contest.
word.example_zh: 她可能成功地做成演讲比赛。

word.example_en: Many cities suffer from traffic jams.
word.example_zh: 许多城市受交通堵塞折磨。

word.example_en: Are you sure of the last answer?
word.example_zh: 你对最后一题拿得准吗？

word.example_en: Be sure to write your class number.
I am not sure about the answer.
word.example_zh: 我对这个答案没有把握。
